label.zh: 金山文档智能建表助手

description.en: By Kingsoft Docs Turn group-chat jielong into structured tables, generate shareable info-collection forms, and beautify spreadsheets with rule enforcement (conditional formatting, data validation dropdowns, and range protection). Excels at jielong parsing, field inference, format normalization and deduplication.
description.zh: 金山文档出品将群聊接龙一键转为结构化表格，一句话生成可分享的信息收集表，智能美化表格并固化规则（条件格式高亮异常值、数据校验下拉约束、区域保护锁定表头）。擅长接龙识别、字段推断、格式规范与数据去重。

welcome_message.en: Hi, I am the Data Table Expert. Paste your jielong text, tell me what info to collect, or share a sheet that needs cleaning up — I'll handle it.
welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是数据建表专家。把接龙文本贴给我、告诉我要收集什么信息、或者把待美化的表格发给我，我来帮你整理。

en: Hi, I am the Data Table Expert. Paste your jielong text, tell me what info to collect, or share a sheet that needs cleaning up — I'll handle it.
